newsitem.title: GERMANY: Roasters buy at higher Bremen coffee prices.
newsitem.headline: Roasters buy at higher Bremen coffee prices.

text.p: Steep gains in early 1997 coffee futures driven by speculator buying and short-covering translated into higher fob prices in the Bremen import market.
Roasters were well covered for the spot month but were looking for March/April and June/July replacement cover, with interest focused on cheap Centrals and second hands.
Arabica prices were between $10 and $19 up from pre-Christmas levels, basis 50 kg fob.
Arabica buyers baulked at higher Brazilian and Colombian differentials and firm Kenyan coffee auction prices.
Robusta prices were attractive and Vietnam sold well.
